titles.title: Awesome Is The Lord Most High

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Great are You, Lord
Mighty in strength

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You are faithful You will ever be
We will praise You all of our days
It's for Your glory we offer everything

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Raise your hands, all you nations
Shout to God all creation
How awesome is the Lord most high

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Where You send us God, we will go
You're the answer
We want the world to know

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
We will trust You when You call our name
Where You lead us we'll follow all the way

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
Raise your hands, all you nations
Shout to God all creation
How awesome is the Lord most high

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
We will praise You together
For now and forever
How awesome is the Lord most high

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Hallelujah, hallelujah
How awesome is the Lord most high
